description: Find and remove duplicate records (CRM contacts, leads, customers, products) in a JSON array. Modes: exact, normalized (emails: case, Gmail dots and +tags; phones: punctuation and country prefix; URLs: scheme, www, tracking params; names: accents, honorifics, word order; companies: Inc / Ltd / GmbH suffixes) and fuzzy (Jaro-Winkler / token similarity with weighted fields, blocking + sorted neighbourhood so 5,000 records stay fast). Groups transitive matches, keeps the first / last / most complete record, optionally merges missing fields from the duplicates, and returns the unique records plus every duplicate group with its score. Price: $0.003 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/dedupe-records

merge.description: Fill empty fields of the kept record from its duplicates

types.description: Optional field → type map (email, phone, url, name, company, text, number, exact); auto-detected from field names and values otherwise
